requirements.title: NUM_IMAGES TEAM and TEAM_NUMBER argument restrictions
requirements.definition: TEAM shall be a scalar TEAM_TYPE identifying the current or an ancestor team; TEAM_NUMBER shall be an integer scalar identifying the initial team or a sibling team of the current team.
